buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Scope of Supply (Bid price to include all cost components): The firm has to supply the material as per the OFA’s Monitoring Instruction and Drawing. Inspection shall be carried out at OFA’s premises by represe ntative of ED/OFA. 2) Bidder should upload OFA’s Monitoring Instruction and Drawing duly signed & stamped on it for acce ptance along with their offer, failing which offer may be rejected. 3) Turnover – The bidders should have average annual turnover of ₹1 Lakh for the last three FY 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26. The bidders should submit documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance sheets of releva nt periods or a certificate from the Charted Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. 4) Commercial Experience Eligibility Criteria – The bidder should be registered (or) established for the supply of similar/relevant item (Carbide Die/Carbid e Tools/Carbide Inserts/Carbide Punch) in Ordnance Factory Ambarnath or other Ordnance Factories. (OR ) The bidder should be Manufacturer or Supplier of similar/relevant item (Carbide Die/Carbide Tools/Carbide Inserts/Carbide Punch) in Ordnance Factory Ambarnath / Sister Ordnance Factories / State Govt. Departm ents / Central Govt. / PSU / Public Listed firms / Reputed Private firms during the last 07 years ending on th e last day of the month immediately preceding the month in which the last date of bid submission falls and submitted executed supply order copy as follows: I. Three supply orders each for supply of similar/relevant item (Carbide Die/Carbide Tools/Carbide Insert s/Carbide Punch) where executed each value is not less than the amount of ₹49,990/- (OR)

II. Two supply orders each for supply of similar/relevant item (Carbide Die/Carbide Tools/Carbide Inserts/ Carbide Punch) where executed each value is not less than the amount of ₹66,654/- (OR) III. One supply order for supply of similar/relevant item (Carbide Die/Carbide Tools/Carbide Inserts/Carbi de Punch) where executed value is not less than the amount of ₹1,16,644/- The last day of order execution may fall in the above-mentioned period. For the proof of past experiences: Bidder must submit copies of executed relevant purchase orders (Purch ase Order Copies along with Invoice/ Acceptance Certificate/ CRAC Certificate) as documentary evidence o f experience. 5) The benefits of prior experience and prior turnover shall be relaxed for DPIIT-recognized Startups, as per applicable Government of India/GeM provisions, only where the Startup bidder is the actual manufactur er of the relevant tendered item (Carbide Die/Carbide Tools/Carbide Inserts/Carbide Punch). 6) The benefits of MSE purchase preference and other applicable MSE benefits such as prior experience and prior turnover criteria shall be available only to actual manufacturer of the relevant tendered item (Ca rbide Die/Carbide Tools/Carbide Inserts/Carbide Punch) and those bidders who have claimed/applied for M SE benefit on the GeM portal at the time of submission of the bid and who possess a valid Udyam Registrat ion Certificate (URC) indicating (relevant NIC Code for Carbide Die/Carbide Tools/Carbide Inserts/Carbide P unch) covering the relevant activity/product being offered. Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): This Policy is meant for procurement of only goods produced (Manufacturer) by MSEs. Traders/ distributors/ sole agent/ Works Contract are exclud ed from the purview of the policy. NIC code: To get exemption / purchase preferences especially Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) for offer ed goods in tender, the National Industrial Classification (NIC) code listed in bidder Udyam Registration Cer tificate / MSME certificate to claim exemptions / purchase preferences for offered product should match th e offered product category (Carbide Die/Carbide Tools/Carbide Inserts/ Carbide Punch). 7) Payment Terms - 100% Payment on delivery and acceptance of material at factory premises, which c an be accepted. In such cases, payment is to be made within 45 days of receipt and acceptance of materia ls at the factory premises along with requisite/relevant documents from suppliers. 8) NOTE - Supply orders where the GST amount shall exceed ₹5,000/-, the invoices should be uploaded i mmediately by the supplier in his GSTR-1 / IFF so that the invoice appears in GSTR-2B of the branches, if n ot found in GSTR-2B of the branches, payment should be withheld unless it so appears in the GSTR-2B of t he branches. 9) The Seller/Supplier shall generate and upload the GeM Invoice along with the applicable GST Invoice on the GeM portal at the time of dispatch of the material, for each consignment/supply. 10) Liquidated damages, Force majeure clause shall be applicable as per YILSPM-2024 and GeM GTC. 11) Arbitration clause shall be applicable as per YILSPM-2024 clause no 3.26. 12) In case of any query, email to ofapv@ord.gov.in. .
